title: Hostel वाली selfie से LinkedIn वाली photo
experiment: E1 visible magic: the result is a before and after the eye sees in one second (my selfie in a hoodie, then the same face in a blazer under studio light). Also the first reel of channel test T2 (the series and the follow line after the first payoff).
look: illustrated story (brand/story.js, brand/scenes.js), my face and body (hoodie, then blazer), Rohan as the friend, Priya Ma'am as the interviewer, compact captions
style: Natural conversational Hindi as spoken in India, like a friend who tells you a short story and lets you in on a useful find. English words in Indian English. Confident, clear and brisk, one even tone for the whole story, with only a short breath between sentences. No acting, no exaggeration.
sources: https://gemini.google/overview/image-generation/ (captured 2026-10-16, India): 'Bring your wildest ideas to life ... with Nano Banana. Available for free. Upgrade to a Google AI Plan to unlock Nano Banana 2.1'; model table: 'Nano Banana 2, Image generation and editing model, Free of charge'; 'One visual, many sizes. Make your creations look professional everywhere that you share them. Instantly resize them to fit whatever format you require'; 'Try out different looks with Gemini. Ready for a makeover?'; 'Upload a pic to Gemini & prompt'; footnote 'Compatibility and availability vary. Limits apply. 18+.'
https://gemini.google/subscriptions/ (captured 2026-10-16, India): 'Free of charge ... ₹0 INR/month with a Google Account'; Gemini app: 'Image generation and editing'.
claims: Photo editing in Gemini is free: both pages (free of charge, ₹0, with limits; the caption says 'limits के साथ').
Upload a selfie and write one line: the page shows 'Upload a pic to Gemini & prompt'.
Any size: 'Instantly resize them to fit whatever format you require'.
Not claimed: that it works for passports or government ID (Indian passport photos must not be digitally altered), any number of free images per day, or the paid model.
prompt: Turn this selfie into a professional LinkedIn headshot. Keep my face exactly the same. Navy blazer, white shirt, plain grey background, soft studio light, chest up.
prompt2: Now give me the same photo as a square profile picture and as a resume photo.

sentences: तुम्हारी hostel वाली selfie अब LinkedIn वाली professional photo है।
बिना photographer और बिना blazer के।
कल placement का form भरना है।
Formal photo चाहिए और phone में बस ऐसी selfies हैं।
तभी Rohan बोलता है कि Gemini में डाल दे।
और बस यह एक line लिखो।
चेहरा तुम्हारा ही है पर अब blazer और studio वाली light में।
ऐसे और AI जुगाड़ के लिए follow कर लो।
एक line और लिखो और यही photo हर size में तैयार है।
Interview में Priya Ma'am ने पहले यही पूछा कि photo कहाँ खिंचवाई।
तुमने मुस्कुराकर कहा कि एक जुगाड़ है।
Comment में कुछ भी लिख दो।
Placement वाले दोस्त को भेज दो।
